meta.title: Bonjour — Learn French that you can actually use

about.title: About Bonjour
about.intro: Bonjour is a calm platform for adults learning French for real life — work, travel, daily situations — not for chasing points.
about.whyBody: Every step is tied to a can-do goal: something you should be able to do in French. Progress only shows what you have demonstrated.
about.how2: Learn the language you need for it
about.how5: Move to the next clear step
about.honestBody: We do not invent mastery scores, hide weak skills, or send you to other websites for core learning. Materials stay on Bonjour.

landing.howStep5: Move to the next clear step
